title: THE FALSE DEFENSE
briefing: A turbine accumulates momentum. Every cycle, the momentum grows by the drive, and the drive itself grows by one. If momentum ever goes negative, the turbine reverses and tears itself apart.

intro: WRITE THE OBVIOUS LAW, LAWSMITH. I DARE YOU.
MOMENTUM ONLY GROWS. UNTIL IT DOES NOT.

default: Watch the drive y, not just the momentum.
Momentum grows by the drive. If the drive could go negative, so could momentum.
One Law can guard two gauges at once: that is what AND is for.
